name: Apply LoRAs
description: The model with LoRAs applied, each at its own strength, in row order. Pick a LoRA in the last row and a new row appears; set one back to None to take its row out. Wire the result to both Text Encode and Sampler.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.label: Strength
inputs.description: How strongly the LoRA changes the model: 0 not at all, 1 as trained.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.label: On
inputs.description: Off leaves the LoRA out without losing its row.
